messages:
sam: noticed after the 09:58 deploy the latency dashboard lost p95/p99 lines for all endpoints. p50 is fine, p95/p99 just not rendering. anyone else seeing this? :thinking:

deploy-bot: deployment rtx-service@2026-11-30T09:58 UTC completed by leila (rollout id: rtx-20261130-0958) :rocket:

anya: looking now. which dashboard? the Console > Latency > Global?

sam: yep the Global one and the per-model routes. curious because raw token latency in traces still shows spikes but the percentile lines missing. attached screenshot: https://files.redwood.dev/shot123.png

mike: quick sanity check — prometheus/exporter still scraping? can you paste the metric name you're expecting?

sam: frontend expects metrics named like `request_latency_p95` and `request_latency_p99` (legacy panel). backend used to push those via metrics-aggregator job.

anya: running a direct query against observability-api for `request_latency_p95`... returning 0 series. querying `request_latency` histogram: series present with label `quantile="0.95"` removed. hmm.

leila: I pushed a small refactor in rtx-service that switched to histogram summaries and removed explicit pXX counters. thought the aggregator handled quantiles. commit 9f3a1b2. cc @anya

anya: digging into metrics-aggregator logs. at 10:01 it starts crashing briefly: `TypeError: cannot read property 'labels' of undefined` then continues. aggregator is defaulting to dropping derived p95/p99 metrics on error.

opsbot: incident created: INC-20261130-04 - latency percentiles missing on Console. Priority=P2.

mike: if aggregator skipped emitting p95/p99, frontend panels that expect those exact metric names will render nothing. two options: 1) update panels to use histogram quantile() queries, 2) restore emission of p95/p99 in aggregator. which is quicker?

sam: short-term rollback to pre-9f3a1b2 would restore old metric names. can we rollback?

leila: I can rollback the rtx-service to v20261129-2210. rolling back now.

deploy-bot: rollback rtx-service@v20261129-2210 triggered by leila (id: rollback-1756789150) :arrows_counterclockwise:

anya: after rollback, aggregator logs show p95/p99 emission resumed at 10:19. frontend panels still need cache invalidation (dashboard caches TTL 5m).

sam: confirmed screenshot now shows p95/p99 lines back at 10:24. looks fixed for users. thanks team. :tada:

mike: follow-up action: 1) add guard in aggregator so transient TypeErrors don't drop derived metrics (aya). 2) update Console dashboards to prefer histogram/quantile() queries (longer term). 3) postmortem to explain why refactor removed compatibility. assigning opsbot to track.

opsbot: follow-up task created: OPS-789 - harden metrics-aggregator + migrate dashboards to quantile() queries. due 2026-12-07.

leila: sorry about the break — I should have run aggregator integration tests. will open a PR with compatibility shim this afternoon.

anya: nice catch, sam. closing thread once postmortem linked.

sam: thanks everyone. leaving notes in INC-20261130-04 and will ping product owners about dashboard migration.
